question: After the flux-separated total-action result, is there a same-future, equal-public-flux correction pair on the fixed L=2 geometry, and can the existing one-error/one-first-record exact law identify a matched expected logical risk?
role: Two-branch deterministic design prerequisite; neither a charge Born-law comparison nor a logical-risk experiment
source_basis: Jing ideal red-X support and public flux convention
J6V pinned shortest simple red-edge cycle
Lab 004 ground-state-relative logical loss and posterior-versus-risk distinction

matrix.loop_toggled_public_action: symmetric difference of baseline action with the exact J6V canonical six-red-edge simple cycle; no edge or action may be selected after seeing outcomes
matrix.same_flux_branch: For both fixed future keys compare baseline and loop-toggled red-X action. Require the J6V cycle to have zero public flux boundary, distinct final physical supports, and exactly equal next public flux. This is a necessary geometry condition only; its homology, physical admissibility, first-record law and full charge law remain separate gates
matrix.risk_branch: Inspect J7I's fixed single private initial error, selected first record and conditional public laws. A matched expected logical-loss comparison requires a declared physical-error distribution over independent histories, the same public observation/sampling design, a declared ground-state-relative Boolean-union score, and pairable exogenous keys. Mark it unavailable if J7I has no such ensemble; do not calculate a risk from one fixed private error
matrix.independent_unit_uncertainty: Deterministic support and estimand-availability audit; no stochastic sampling unit or interval

competing_outcomes.geometry_candidate_only: Both future columns have a same-flux distinct-action pair. Register a separate exact charge-law study only after logical/homology, public-action, full-record and compute-cap gates; no charge information gain follows from geometry alone
competing_outcomes.geometry_censored: No verified same-flux admissible pair; do not compare action-conditioned charge laws by conditioning on a post-action flux
competing_outcomes.risk_not_identified: J7I's one-error fixture lacks an exogenous error ensemble and matching expected-loss denominator; preserve the finite public-law result but do not label it risk
competing_outcomes.risk_identified: Only if a frozen physical-error ensemble, paired denominator, public record and loss are already present, record their exact provenance before any numerical risk evaluation

acceptance: Five pins pass before and after
Both fixed-future geometry pairs reconcile in the pinned periodic red-edge map, with zero loop boundary and explicit support/flux records
The risk verdict checks the J7I one-error/one-record design and lists missing denominator/provenance without inventing a loss estimate
The two branches retain separate outcomes and no charge, logical-risk, five-round caller or threshold claim is promoted
No Born-law, stochastic history, schedule arm, bootstrap or caller mutation
stop_rule: Stop on pin, cycle, flux-map, cell-count or CPU-bound failure. Do not substitute another loop, select an action post-data, run charge projectors, infer winding class, invent a physical-error prior or reuse withdrawn risk data.
